questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Downcast
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Downcast
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e., 'Cheerful'.

Key Points

  • Downcast is an adjective which means (of a person) feeling despondent or sad.
  • The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
    • Disappointed - fail to fulfil the hopes or expectations of.
    • Distressed - suffering from extreme anxiety, sorrow, or pain.
    • Successful - accomplishing a desired aim or result.
    • Cheerful - noticeably happy and optimistic.
  • From the above meanings it is evident that cheerful is the correct antonym for the word downcast.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Fecund
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fecund
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e., 'Barren'.

Key Points

  • Fecund  is an adjective which means producing or capable of producing an abundance of offspring or new growth; highly fertile. (प्रचुर मात्रा में संतान या नई वृद्धि पैदा करने या पैदा करने में सक्षम; अत्यधिक उपजाऊ।)
  • The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
    • Genial - friendly and cheerful. (मिलनसार और हंसमुख।)
    • Polite - having or showing behaviour that is respectful and considerate of other people. (ऐसा व्यवहार करना या दिखाना जो अन्य लोगों के प्रति सम्मानजनक और विचारशील हो।)
    • Rude - offensively impolite or bad-mannered. (आक्रामक रूप से अभद्र या बुरे आचरण वाला।)
    • Barren - (of land) too poor to produce much or any vegetation. ((भूमि का) बहुत अधिक या किसी वनस्पति का उत्पादन करने के लिए बहुत गरीब।)
  • From the above meanings it is evident that barren is the correct antonym for the word fecund.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Famished

Famished

The correct answer is option "Satiated"

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the given word.

  • Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
    • Volatile: of a person) liable to display rapid changes of emotion.
    • Hesitant: tentative, unsure, or slow in acting or speaking.
    • Starved: suffer or die or cause to suffer or die from hunger.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

  • As per the meaning of the given options, "satiated" is the antonym of "famished".

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Conceit
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Conceit
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Modesty'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Conceit' is 'Modesty'.
  • Conceit: too much pride in yourself and your abilities and importance. (अहंकार, घमंड)
    • Example: He may be so conceited to believe that he is competent when he is not.
  • Modesty: the quality of not talking about or not trying to make people notice your abilities and achievements. (लोगों को आपकी क्षमताओं और उपलब्धियों के बारे में बात न करने या न करने की कोशिश करने का गुण)
    • Example: She does a lot of work for charities, but her modesty forbids her from talking about it.
       

Correct Answer: Modesty.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Concealment: the action of hiding something or preventing it from being known. (किसी चीज को छिपाने या ज्ञात होने से रोकने की क्रिया)
    • Reveal: to make something known that was secret or unknown before. [(गुप्‍त या पूर्वतः अज्ञात वस्‍तु को) प्रकट करना, रहस्‍य खोल लेना]
    • Hidden: to put or keep somebody/something in a place where he/she/it cannot be seen; to cover something so that it cannot be seen. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को ऐसी जगह रखना जहाँ कोई देख न सके, छिपाना; किसी वस्‍तु को ऐसे ढकना कि वह दिखाई न दे, छिपा देना)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word. Technology plays an indispensable role in the lives of human beings in the 21 st century.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Technology plays an indispensable role in the lives of human beings in the 21st century.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Superfluous

Key Points 

  • Indispensable: Incapable of being disregarded or neglected. (अपरिहार्य; उपेक्षित या उपेक्षित होने में असमर्थ)
  • Let us look at the meaning of the words given in the options section.
    • Superfluous: Unnecessary, especially through being more than enough. (ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा; अनावश्यक, विशेष रूप से पर्याप्त से अधिक होने के कारण)
    • Relentless: Something that is harsh, unforgiving, and persistent. (कुछ ऐसा जो कठोर, अक्षम्य और लगातार बना रहे; दयाहीन)
    • Vigilant: Keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties. (चौकस)
    • Transparent: easy to perceive or detect; (of a material or article) allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen. (पारदर्शी)
  • From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of 'Indispensable' is 'Superfluous'.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Let's understand the meaning of the highlighted word:

 Let's understand the meaning of the correct word:

  • Unconvincing: failing to make someone believe that something is true or valid.

  • It is evident from the above explanation that "unconvincing" is the antonym of "cogent".
  • Therefore, the correct answer is: Unconvincing

Additional Information Let's understand the meaning of the remaining options:

Word Meaning
Compelling evoking interest, attention, or admiration in a powerfully irresistible way

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Bulk
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Bulk
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Handful".

Key Points

  • Antonyms are words having the opposite meanings of another word.
  • The word 'bulk' means in large amount or quantity; or most of the part of something.
  • While the word 'handful' has the opposite meaning of the word 'bulk'.
  • The meaning of the word 'handful' is a small amount of something; as much of something as we can take in one hand.
  • Example: She wants a handful of nuts.

Additional Information

  • Heavy means having a lot of weight.
    • Example: Saumya is carrying a heavy box.
  • Staple - It is a small bent pin that is used to fasten a lot of papers together.
    • Example: Can you staple my documents?
  • Brunt - the main impact or force of something, usually something negative. It can also mean the heaviest or most unpleasant part of a task or burden.
    • Example: The brunt of the storm hit the coastal towns hardest, causing widespread flooding and destruction.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word. The natural environment is in contrast with the 'built environment' which refers to areas that have been fundamentally transformed and influenced by human activity, such as cities, towns, substructures and so on.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The natural environment is in contrast with the 'built environment' which refers to areas that have been fundamentally transformed and influenced by human activity, such as cities, towns, substructures and so on.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. Fair.

Key Points

  • Influenced refers to to have an effect on or power over somebody/something so that he/she/it changes. (प्रभाव) 
  • "Fair" refers to treating people equally without favoritism or discrimination; just. (उचित)
    • Example: The judge gave a fair ruling based on the evidence presented.
  • The natural environment is untouched and pure, while the built environment is constructed and altered by human action. Hence, the antonym of built is more accurately related to being fair and unprejudiced.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Hackneyed (पुराना): Something that is unoriginal or overused.
    • Example: The hackneyed phrase lost its charm due to overuse.
  • Inimical (हानिकारक): Something that is harmful or hostile.
    • Example: The inimical weather conditions made it impossible to proceed with the expedition.
  • Interested (रुचि रखने वाला): Showing curiosity or a desire to know or learn about something.
    • Example: She is very interested in learning about different cultures.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word. Managers who delegate reduce their work load.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Managers who delegate reduce their work load.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Retain.

Key Points

  • The word 'delegate' is a verb in this context, meaning to entrust tasks or responsibilities to others (Hindi meaning: प्रतिनिधि मनोनीत करना). 
    • For example, "The supervisor decided to delegate some tasks to the new intern."
  • The correct antonym is 'retain', which in this context means to keep or continue to have something (Hindi meaning: बरकरार रखना).
    • For example, "Despite the presence of capable staff, the boss chose to retain all the responsibilities herself."

Therefore, the correct answer is "Retain".

Additional Information

  • Appoint: It refers to the act of assigning a job or position to someone (Hindi meaning: नियुक्त करना).
  • Nominate: It means to formally suggest someone for a position, role, or duty (Hindi meaning: मनोनीत करना).
  • Depute: This verb is another term for delegating duties or authority to someone else (Hindi meaning: प्रतिनिधि मनोनीत करना).

questions.questionHtml:

Selective
questions.solution:
The correct antonym is: Careless.Key Points

  • "Selective" means carefully choosing the best or most suitable, so the antonym would be not careful in choosing, which "Careless" represents. (चयनात्मक)
  • "Careless" implies a lack of concern or attention, which would be the opposite of the careful selection implied by "Selective." (लापरवाह)
    • For example: She was careless with her belongings and often misplaced her keys.

​Therefore, the correct antonym is: Careless.​​

Additional Information

  •  "Stimulating" means something that is exciting or invigorating.(प्रेरक)

  • "Doubtful" reflects a lack of conviction or certainty.(संदेहपूर्ण)

  • "Planned" means something that is prepared for in advance.(योजनाबद्ध)
